caps: This temple | was never BUILT.
It was CARVED | from ONE rock.
*Kailasa*, at *Ellora*. | *Shiva's* mountain, | in stone.
lines.tts: Kailaasa, at Ellora. Shiva's mountain, in stone.

caps: No bricks. No blocks. | No mortar.
Just one hill | of solid rock.
1,200 years ago, they | cut three trenches
straight down | into the hill,
lines.tts: Twelve hundred years ago, they cut three trenches straight down into the hill,

caps: and left an island | of rock standing.
Then they carved | that island | from the TOP down.
The tower first. | Then the halls.
Then the floor | they stood on.
Up to | 200,000 TONNES | of rock
cut away | by HAND.
lines.tts: Up to two hundred thousand tonnes of rock, cut away by hand.

caps: Nothing could be | added back.
Every strike | was FINAL.
What remained: | a shrine over | 30 metres tall,
lines.tts: What remained: a shrine over thirty metres tall,

caps: held up by | stone ELEPHANTS.
*Nandi* in his | own pavilion,
joined by | a bridge of rock.
And on its wall, | *Ravana* lifting | Mount *Kailash*.
A copper plate | from the year 812
says the gods | in their sky-chariots
were STRUCK | with wonder:
lines.tts: A copper plate from the year eight hundred and twelve says the gods in their sky chariots were struck with wonder:

caps: "This temple | made ITSELF.
Such beauty is | never man-made."
Even its architect | was stunned:
"Oh, how was it | that I BUILT it?"
Which temple | should we explain | NEXT?
Comment its name!
